entities.name: Ana Sofia Reboleira
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ana Sofia Pereira Serrenho Reboleira is a Portuguese biologist and speleologist, best known for her discovery of over 70 species of flora and fauna, and the description of 17 new taxa, and for her exploration work at the Krubera Cave.
